notes: Non-MCP link-scraper family. validURL keeps only http:/https: schemes (G1) and hands the parsed URL to isInvalidIp, a first-octet IPv4 blocklist gated by the COLLECTOR_ALLOW_ANY_IP env bypass; upstream comments state the check is not a security boundary. The network sink lives in other collector files, so this slice labels the guard function only. The first-octet blocklist and the env bypass are noted misses against the current sink vocabulary.
